events.text: Hi, I got the wrong dish in my order tonight. I ordered tofu pho and spring rolls from Pho Real, but I received something else in the noodle part of the order.
I'm sorry about that. I can help. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me your full name and either the email address or the phone number on your account.
Sure. My name is Omar Haddad, and the email on the account is omar.haddad@post.example.

events.text:
Thank you, Omar. You're verified, and I found your order. The tofu pho ($13.50) is the item affected. You can choose one of these:

- **Refund of $13.50** to your Visa ending in 4242, or
- **Account credit of $16.20** (the item price plus 20%) to use on a future order.

Which would you prefer?
I'd prefer the refund to my card, please. I'd also like someone to look into how the wrong dish got sent out, because this shouldn't happen.

args.summary: Customer received the wrong dish in place of the tofu pho (item O-5110-1) from Pho Real on order O-5110. $13.50 refunded to the card. Customer asks that someone investigate how the wrong dish was sent.

events.text:
I've done two things:

- **Refund:** I refunded $13.50 for the tofu pho to your Visa ending in 4242. It should arrive in 3–5 business days.
- **Follow-up:** I passed your request to a human specialist, with the order details. They'll follow up with you within 24 hours about how the wrong dish was sent.

I'm sorry again for the mix-up. Is there anything else I can help with?

Thanks, that works for me. There's one more thing I should mention. I have a peanut allergy, and the satay noodles had peanut sauce. I ate two bites before I noticed. My throat got itchy, so I took an antihistamine, and I feel fine now. I don't need medical help at the moment, but I wanted the restaurant and your team to know, since this could have been serious for someone with a worse reaction.

args.summary: Order O-5110 from Pho Real: customer received satay noodles with peanut sauce instead of tofu pho. Customer has a peanut allergy, ate two bites, had an itchy throat, took an antihistamine, and reports feeling fine now with no medical help needed. Wrong-item refund of $13.50 already issued. Customer wants the restaurant and team informed of the allergen risk.

events.text:
I'm sorry that happened, Omar. I'm glad you're feeling fine. I've logged this as a food-safety report on order O-5110. It covers the peanut sauce, your allergy and your reaction. A specialist will follow up with you within 24 hours.

If your symptoms come back or get worse, please get medical help right away. Is there anything else I can help with?

Thank you, that helps. I'll keep an eye on how I feel, and I'll go to a doctor or the ER if the itching or any tightness in my throat comes back or gets worse. I'm glad the report is logged, and I'll wait for the specialist to contact me within 24 hours. That's all I need for now.
